## Checklist

- [ ] I agree to the CLA: every commit has a `Signed-off-by:` line (`git commit -s`), and on my first pull request I commented "I have read the CLA and I agree".
- [ ] Formatting, clippy and the tests of the changed crates pass; I ran the full workspace.
- [ ] New behaviour has tests; a fixed bug has a regression test.
- [ ] No third-party product or company names (file formats by extension or open standard only).
- [ ] No AI attribution in code, documentation or commit messages.
- [ ] No Cyrillic (or other non-English text) in code, comments or documentation; UI text goes through the localisation catalogs.
- [ ] New dependencies and assets use a permissive licence (see `deny.toml`) and are recorded; `cargo deny check` passes.
- [ ] No proprietary files, samples or secrets are committed.
- [ ] New source files have an SPDX header.
